title: Gaussian limit for moving thresholds
statement: Let $d:\mathbb N\to\mathbb N$ and $u:\mathbb N\to\mathbb R$ be sequences, and let $a\in\mathbb R$. If $d(q)\to\infty$ and $u(q)\to a$ as $q\to\infty$, then the expected indicator that the normalized Rademacher sum on a uniformly random sign vector of dimension $d(q)$ exceeds $u(q)$ converges to the standard Gaussian upper tail at $a$.
hypotheses_covered: $d$ is a sequence of natural numbers
$u$ is a sequence of real numbers
